title: Dreame L50 Ultra Robot Vacuum & Mop $783.20 Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Dreame L50 Ultra Robot Vacuum & Mop $783.20 Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[Apostle0748] Awesome price, I’d do it if I were looking for one.
[Mlapa] Been using it since getting it from the Harvey Norman deal, impressive when it cleans but also misses a lot of spots especially near carpets or mats. Have tried remapping as well, has anyone had similar issues? Used to have a roborock s7 that i upgraded from that didn't have this issue.
[PurchaseAnxiety] TBH I've been pretty blown away by how bad this thing is in a lot of ways, to the point where I'm still not sure if my unit is faulty. Like you said, it seems to miss spots it can easily get to, but also tries to barge it's way into spots it can't get to. Sometimes it seems to just get stuck in a loop passing over the same spots over and over ('Clean Genius' is disabled, so it's not that). Mine also cleans the mop constantly for no reason, even I'm just getting it to the vacuum, so it churns through so much water. The object detection is pretty good (esp. for cords), and the actual vacuuming and mopping isn't bad, it just seems to constantly tripping over it's own 'smarts'. I've actually found myself missing my Lubluelu in some scenarios.
[verio] Mine is rattling when moving on a hardfloor. Sent an email to the support team and… never heard back. Fixed with some tape for padding where the vibration was coming from.
[NBSales] Mine does too. Does my head in as it rattles when in transit. I had the thought it was just mine. Started on the second day of ownership. Where is the vibration coming from because I haven't been able to isolate.
[Desleydee] What is the Harvey Norman trade in deal?
[Bellpop] If the current retail price is $979, why is this a crazy price? Serious question. I have the L10s v2. Interested in knowing whether this is worth the upgrade. Thanks.
[SanguinarySeraph] I don’t know if I’d describe it as crazy, but is basically ATL aside from the HN trade in deal that was a bit of an unusual case.
RRP is $1999 (which is admittedly BS)
Previous sales have generally been $1100-1300 ish
Currently most sales are just under the $1000 mark
This is another $200 cheaper again.
Buy it or don’t, i’m not invested - I’d just been keeping an eye out. As mentioned, I wouldn’t be surprised if it was the same or even cheaper around Black Friday, but that’s another 2 months away.
[djlech] L50 replaced L10 Ultra heat in my house. L50 is 100% better worth the money.
[Averell] How long did you have the L10UH for? I had one (our 1st vacuum robot), and it seemed I got a lemon, luckily I got a refund from JBHifi.
[triks] Unrelated to this deal but can recommend EUFY c28 was $720 couple months back anyone looking it’s a ripper device at that price point. Only complaints water tanks are a bit small and battery could be better otherwise si much better than the POS Ecovacs X1 we bought at 3 x the price.
[Sunnyoz] Is look like you can also get this from TGG with the 20% coupon
[JaxSantiago] Our second storey is mostly carpet. I guess I dont really need the mopping feature? If so, any reco for a robovac that solely features a powerful suction?
[tpenthouse] Same here. Got an old xiaomi gen 1 for wooden floors and its not up to the carpet clean and keeps saying its blocked. I see dyson has just announced a vacuum only model in their new line up
[elitistphoenix] :( - To date though… but yeah was looking at changing up my s5
[Woosta] Got 1 during HN deal, amazing. Would buy another but bought a refurb X40Ultra vs $399, as downstair is smaller and dont need something so powerful.
[Bargainboss99] This is a great machine ! I got it from good guys for some 580 or so $ during the last crazy deal from Harvey Norman and price match with good guys and some Google guys store credit I had.
I upgraded from a l10s and this is a huge upgrade.
Bloody thing always works amazingly without fail. Great mopping !
[Kategs] Any recommendations for a robot vacuum for a very large home with floor boards (no carpet)? I definitely wouldn't use the mopping function. Self emptying, easy programming, reliability and long battery would be my priorities.
[EyyBanane] What's your budget? You could buy this and program to use only the vacuum function, with an option to do mopping at your fingertips :)
[Kategs] Re budget…whatever I need to spend to get a machine that vacuums well and self empties and is easy for a non-tech person to program. Ideally it would be quiet and reasonably fast. Our house is large so the battery would need to be decent and it would be used daily to maintain a clean floor (family of 6). We do a weekly "proper clean" with a Miele vacuum and would prefer to mop with our spray mop at the same time manually. I am certain I wouldn't use a robot mop function.
[QuickToThePointless] Lazy…vacuuming and mopping around the home is a great way to get extra steps in and burn some calories - more of a cardio work out than 30 mins walk around the block
[wanj] its not as good as the DJI Romo P2 or the Dreame Aqua10 Ultra
[Tiotio] Been using the L10s Ultra Gen2, super happy.
